dataGroups._comment: PUBLIC, unauthenticated GET endpoints only — network-first with a short cache fallback for offline browsing. Update the origin below to match the real deployed API domain (see environment.production.ts). Deliberately excludes /restaurants/:id and /restaurants/me since a glob can't tell them apart and /restaurants/me is an authenticated, per-account response (docs/SECURITY.md: never persistently cache authenticated API response bodies).
dataGroups.name: public-browse-api
